run_AFLWFace_get_face_size: run AFLWFace.get_face_size to compute face bounding box string and size from landmarks
run_AFLWFace_check_front: run AFLWFace.check_front to verify if all 19 landmarks fall within the face bounding box
run_save_to_list_file: run save_to_list_file to write face image paths, annotations, and box sizes to a list file
run_AFLWFace_init: run AFLWFace constructor to create a face object with image path, landmarks, mask, and bounding box
run_main_AFLW_processing: run the main script to parse AFLWinfo_release.mat and generate train/test list files with face annotations
